body.message: This is my second follow-up regarding the refund of the security deposit for Apartment 2008, Bayz by Danube, which was vacated last Monday.Despite my previous email and multiple requests, there has still been no response, no update, and no refund processed. I specifically informed your team that I was travelling and urgently required the deposit to be returned before my departure. Unfortunately, this request has been completely ignored.I would like to understand why the refund has still not been paid despite the property being vacated and handed over 6 days ago. This delay is highly unprofessional and unacceptable, especially when there has been no communication from your side.I request that the deposit be transferred immediately to the bank account details already provided and that confirmation of payment be shared without further delay.Please treat this matter as urgent and provide a clear explanation for the delay along with the payment confirmation today.Regards,On Fri, May 22, 2026 at 11:34 AM fäm Living - Deposit refund <deposit@famliving.com> wrote:Dear Salman Arshad,This confirms that we received your email and registered it as ticket #952781980. You can always reply to this email to add additional information. Meanwhile, please note the following:If you paid your security deposit with a payment link before or on arrival, your deposit will be refunded within seven working days.If you paid your security deposit with a credit/debit card or via bank transfer on arrival with your guest relation executive, please expect the deposit to be refunded within a maximum of 14 working days. If you paid your security deposit in cash, it would be refunded in cash within 7 working days.If you have stayed for more than 15 days, then your booking would be considered as a long-term booking. All long-term bookings will be refunded within 14 working days as well.The refund will be processed in full through your preferred mode of payment, subject to a property inspection.To ensure a prompt refund, we kindly request you provide your preferred mode of refund (credit card, local bank account, cash, or international wire) to your dedicated guest relations executive as soon as possible. This will facilitate the timely return of funds to our valued guests.Below are the necessary fields and information required for a swift refund by bank transfer:Booking reference number:Beneficiary Name: Beneficiary Address:Beneficiary Bank Name:Beneficiary Bank Account Details (IBAN):Swift Code: Beneficiary Bank Address:Currency of Account:Sort Code:Kinds regards,Team fäm Living
